narrative.intro: Leidos Biomedical Research obligated $303M in federal contract funds in FY2026 to date, across 105 awards with an average award size of $2.9M. Obligations fell 45.9% year over year. Historical obligations show a peak in FY23 and a decline since: FY21 $935M, FY22 $982M, FY23 $1.2B, FY24 $869M, FY25 $560M, and FY26 $303M. Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) is the largest reported NAICS market in FY2026 to date at $305M. The figures are contract obligations except for award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. Current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date. This snapshot shows current-scale obligations, award-count activity, and the dominant NAICS market for Leidos Biomedical Research in the current fiscal year to date.

Historical obligations for context are FY21 $935M, FY22 $982M, FY23 $1.2B, FY24 $869M, and FY25 $560M.
